overall: The AG found the Swampscott Select Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to announce the results of its executive session minutes reviews, and declined to review the records-request allegation.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly failed to announce in open session the results of its periodic reviews of executive session minutes.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law when it failed to announce the result of reviews of executive session minutes.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly failed to respond to a request for copies of executive session minutes made through the town clerk.
allegations.key_passage: Failure to respond to a request made under the Public Records Law implicates that law, not the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, including announcing in open session the results of each periodic review of executive session minutes.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that similar violations in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
